test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks in the given sentence.**

My teacher said, “Time ______ like an arrow, and fruit ______ like bananas”.
solution: The correct answer is "flies."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Flies"** means (used about a bird, insect, aircraft, etc.) to move through the air.((पक्षी, कीट, विमान आदि का) हवा में गति करना, उड़ना) • To select the most appropriate options to fill in the blanks in the given sentence, we must follow these steps: • In this case, the sentence seems to involve a simile comparing the movement of time to the movement of fruit. • We must notice the pattern established by the first blank,** "Time ______ like an arrow."** • The word** "flies"** in this context creates a simile indicating rapid movement. • We must apply the same pattern to the second blank, maintaining the simile structure. • In this case,** "and fruit ______ like bananas,"** the word that fits the pattern is **"flies."** • The correct answer is Option 3. Correct sentence: *My teacher said, “Time **flies**__ like an arrow, and fruit **__flies__** like bananas”.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Wings: **parts that a bird, insect, etc. uses for flying. (पक्षी आदि का डैना, पर या पंख) • **Travels: **to go from one place to another, especially over a long distance. (यात्रा या सफ़र करना (विशेषतः लंबी दूरी का)) • **Glides: **to move smoothly without noise or effort. (बिना बोले या प्रयास किए कोमलता से सरकना या फिसलना) 18f:T5bb, The correct answer is** "missed the boat".**
